data.title: Dataset inspector

field.accumulation_steps.help: Micro-batches per optimizer update. Effective batch = batch size × accumulation.
field.accumulation_steps.label: Gradient accumulation
field.activation_checkpointing.help: Recompute activations in the backward pass to cut peak memory at the cost of speed.
field.activation_checkpointing.label: Activation checkpointing
field.adaptive_halting.help: Let each token stop looping once its halting probability passes the threshold. Saves compute on easy tokens.
field.adaptive_halting.label: Adaptive halting (ACT)
field.alpha.help: Distillation mix: α × teacher KL + (1 − α) × CE.
field.alpha.label: α (distill)
field.attention_block_size.help: Run long attention in query blocks of this many tokens, each reading only the keys it can see. 0 = one call. Exact; 1024 was fastest across the global and sliding-window layers.
field.attention_block_size.label: Attention block size
field.batch_size.help: Sequences per micro-batch. Limited by memory.
field.batch_size.label: Batch size
field.beta.help: Strength of the KL tie to the reference policy in preference training.
field.beta.label: β (DPO/GRPO)
field.ce_chunk_size.help: Compute the language-model loss in row chunks from the last hidden state, so the [batch, length, vocabulary] logits never exist. 0 = full logits. Exact.
field.ce_chunk_size.label: Loss chunk size
field.cluster_locality_clusters.help: Number of expert clusters for the locality term. 0 chooses it from the expert count.
field.cluster_locality_clusters.label: Clusters
field.cluster_locality_mode.help: What one stream is for the cluster constraint. window: fixed windows of the length above. segment: each document of the batch (split at the data's own separators, long ones cut to the window), so similar documents learn to share a cluster without labels or task tags.
field.cluster_locality_mode.label: Locality unit
field.cluster_locality_window.help: Segment length (tokens) the cluster constraint applies to. Best results matched the typical record length.
field.cluster_locality_window.label: Locality window
field.coda_layers.help: Layers that run once after the loop, before the output head.
field.coda_layers.label: Coda layers
field.cpu_budget_percent.help: Share of physical cores auto may use, in percent.
field.cpu_budget_percent.label: CPU budget
field.cpu_threads.help: Threads for PyTorch/BLAS. auto uses the physical-core budget.
field.cpu_threads.label: CPU threads
field.depth_schedule.help: How training chooses the depth per batch: fixed, adaptive, or fixed for a warm-up and then adaptive.
field.depth_schedule.label: Depth schedule
field.depth_schedule_warmup_fraction.hel: Fraction of training that runs at fixed full depth before the schedule becomes adaptive.
field.document_masking.help: Packed rows: attention stays inside each document, cut at the separator token.
field.document_masking.label: Document masking
field.draft_exit_depth.help: Recurrent depth whose exit is trained as the speculative draft.
field.draft_exit_depth.label: Draft depth (training)
field.draft_exit_kl_coef.help: Extra KL between the draft-depth exit and the full-depth output, for self-speculative decoding. 0 disables it.
field.draft_exit_kl_coef.label: Draft-exit KL
field.dropout.help: Random activation dropout during training. Lower it for large datasets; raise it for tiny ones.
field.dropout.label: Dropout
field.dtype.help: Numeric precision for training and inference. Auto picks bfloat16 where the backend supports it, otherwise float32.
field.dtype.label: Compute dtype
field.epochs.help: Passes over the dataset. Max steps, when set, stops earlier.
field.epochs.label: Epochs
field.export.auto_cluster.help: Group co-used experts into pages from calibration data, so lazy loading reads fewer files.
field.export.auto_cluster.label: Build clusters
field.export.calibration_data_path.help: Text used to measure which experts are used together, one path per line; several are merged. Empty skips automatic clustering.
field.export.calibration_data_path.label: Calibration data
field.export.cluster_batch_size.label: Calibration batch size
field.export.cluster_device.label: Calibration device
field.export.cluster_max_batches.help: Number of batches observed for clustering.
field.export.cluster_max_batches.label: Calibration batches
field.export.cluster_max_seq_len.label: Calibration length
field.export.config_path.help: Override the sidecar config. Usually empty.
field.export.config_path.label: Config file
field.export.copy_cache.help: Include the lazy-expert pages in the export so serving starts without rebuilding.
field.export.copy_cache.label: Copy expert cache
field.export.expert_cache_dir.help: Existing lazy-expert cache to package. Empty builds one.
field.export.expert_cache_dir.label: Expert cache
field.export.formats.help: Containers to write. Safetensors and GGUF keep the Chronos metadata; run them with chronos serve. Ollama clients connect to chronos serve, not stock Ollama.
field.export.formats.label: Formats
field.export.model_path.label: Checkpoint
field.export.output_dir.help: Where the export files are written.
field.export.output_dir.label: Output folder
field.fallback_mask_prob.help: During training, randomly hide experts so the model tolerates a cache miss. Only matters for lazy inference with fallback.
field.fallback_mask_prob.label: Miss simulation
field.grad_clip.help: Clip the global gradient norm to this value. 0 disables clipping.
field.grad_clip.label: Gradient clip
field.halting_threshold.help: Cumulative halting probability at which a token stops iterating. Closer to 1 runs deeper.
field.halting_threshold.label: Halting threshold
field.hidden_size.help: Width of every token vector. Larger is more capable but grows parameters roughly quadratically. Must be divisible by the number of attention heads.
field.hidden_size.label: Hidden size
field.infer.backend.help: Runtime for inference. Auto chooses from the checkpoint and the machine.
field.infer.backend.label: Backend
field.infer.decode_wait_s.help: Wait for a prefetched expert before loading it on demand.
field.infer.decode_wait_s.label: Decode wait (s)
field.infer.draft_depth.label: Draft depth
field.infer.gamma.label: Draft length γ
field.infer.max_tokens.label: Max new tokens
field.infer.miss_policy.help: What a cache miss does. sync_on_demand gives output identical to full memory.
field.infer.miss_policy.label: Miss policy
field.infer.mode.help: compare runs lazy and full memory side by side; offload runs lazy experts only; fullload loads everything.
field.infer.mode.label: Mode
field.infer.model_path.help: The .pth checkpoint to run. Its sidecar config decides the architecture.
field.infer.model_path.label: Checkpoint
field.infer.paging.help: auto follows the checkpoint: cluster pages when trained with cluster locality, otherwise per expert.
field.infer.paging.label: Paging layout
field.infer.ram_load_ratio.help: Fraction of experts kept in RAM. Above 1.0 adds slack for prefetching.
field.infer.ram_load_ratio.label: RAM ratio
field.infer.raw_prompt.help: Send the text as is, without the chat template.
field.infer.raw_prompt.label: Raw prompt
field.infer.residency_decay.help: How fast the planner forgets older routing evidence.
field.infer.residency_decay.label: Planner decay
field.infer.residency_planner.help: Evict the expert needed furthest in the future instead of the least recently used one.
field.infer.residency_planner.label: Next-use planner
field.infer.speculative.help: Draft tokens at shallow depth and verify them at full depth. Output is unchanged; at 50M it was measured slower, so it is off by default.
field.infer.speculative.label: Self-speculative decoding
field.infer.sweep_ram_ratios.help: Run every standard ratio and chart speed and hit rate against memory.
field.infer.sweep_ram_ratios.label: Sweep RAM ratios
field.infer.temperature.help: Sampling randomness. 0 is greedy and reproducible.
field.infer.temperature.label: Temperature
field.infer.verify_wait_s.help: Same wait for the speculative verify pass.
field.infer.verify_wait_s.label: Verify wait (s)
field.kv_cache_dtype.help: auto keeps the compute dtype; int8 quantizes the inference KV cache per token (about half the memory, small error). Training is never quantized.
field.kv_cache_dtype.label: KV cache dtype
field.kv_latent_dim.help: Width of the compressed key/value latent cached by MLA layers. Smaller saves KV memory.
field.kv_latent_dim.label: MLA latent size
field.kv_quant_group_size.help: Channels that share one int8 scale. Smaller groups are more accurate and slightly larger.
field.kv_quant_group_size.label: KV quant group
field.lambda_balance.help: Pushes the router to spread tokens evenly across experts.
field.lambda_balance.label: Load balance
field.lambda_cluster_locality.help: Trains tokens in a segment to stay inside one expert cluster, so lazy inference can page whole clusters. 0 disables it.
field.lambda_cluster_locality.label: Cluster locality
field.lambda_iteration_cluster.help: Weight on keeping every loop iteration of a token inside the same expert clusters (experts inside a cluster may still differ per iteration). 0 disables it.
field.lambda_iteration_cluster.label: Iteration cluster locality
field.lambda_lookahead.help: Trains the lookahead router to predict the experts future tokens will use.
field.lambda_lookahead.label: Lookahead loss
field.lambda_lookahead_topk.help: Extra weight on getting the exact top-k future experts right.
field.lambda_lookahead_topk.label: Lookahead top-k
field.lambda_lookahead_union.help: Weight on covering the union of experts over the lookahead window.
field.lambda_lookahead_union.label: Lookahead union
field.lambda_or.help: Weight of the odds-ratio term in ORPO.
field.lambda_or.label: λ (ORPO)
field.lambda_router_anchor.help: Keeps routing close to the upstream checkpoint during fine-tuning. 0 for pretraining.
field.lambda_router_anchor.label: Router anchor
field.lambda_router_locality.help: Mild penalty on routing changes between neighbouring tokens.
field.lambda_router_locality.label: Router locality
field.lambda_temporal.help: Rewards consecutive tokens for choosing the same experts, so fewer experts are loaded per stretch of text.
field.lambda_temporal.label: Temporal locality
field.layer_aware_cache.help: Track resident experts per virtual layer instead of per physical layer.
field.layer_aware_cache.label: Layer-aware cache
field.learning_rate.help: Peak optimizer step size. The planner suggests one from the model size; lower it for fine-tuning.
field.learning_rate.label: Learning rate
field.log_interval.help: Write a metrics row every N steps.
field.log_interval.label: Log interval
field.lookahead_input_detach.help: The lookahead router reads a gradient-free copy of the hidden state, so its losses train only the router. Measured neutral on the en-zh data.
field.lookahead_input_detach.label: Detach lookahead input
field.lookahead_steps.help: How many future tokens the lookahead router predicts experts for, so they can be prefetched before they are needed.
field.lookahead_steps.label: Lookahead steps
field.lookahead_teacher_scope.help: Which routing the LookaheadRouter learns to predict. first: loop iteration 0 only. iterations: the average over every iteration of the layer, so prefetch also covers the experts deeper iterations need.
field.lookahead_teacher_scope.label: Lookahead teacher
field.max_gen_len.label: Rollout length
field.max_inference_depth.help: Maximum iterations at inference. Usually equal to the training depth; more than trained is not validated.
field.max_inference_depth.label: Inference depth
field.max_position_embeddings.help: Longest sequence the rotary embedding is prepared for. Only change it for very long contexts.
field.max_position_embeddings.label: Max positions
field.max_resident_experts.help: Hard cap on experts kept in memory per layer. Empty lets the planner decide.
field.max_resident_experts.label: Max resident experts
field.max_seq_len.help: Tokens per training sequence. Longer costs memory roughly linearly with hybrid attention.
field.max_seq_len.label: Sequence length
field.max_steps.help: Stop after this many optimizer steps. 0 means no cap (run all epochs).
field.max_steps.label: Max steps
field.min_recurrent_depth.help: Lowest depth the schedule or early exit may use. 1 lets easy tokens exit after one pass.
field.min_recurrent_depth.label: Minimum depth
field.mla_cache_rope.help: Also cache the rotary key part, trading KV memory for decode speed.
field.mla_cache_rope.label: Cache RoPE keys
field.mla_decode.help: expanded: reference path. absorbed: folds projections into the query (less compute per step). auto mixes paths and showed a small logit gap, so it stays opt-in.
field.mla_decode.label: MLA decode path
field.mla_upproj_recompute.help: Keep only the latent and rebuild K and V per attention block. Exact, but measured no memory gain at 64k, so it stays off.
field.mla_upproj_recompute.label: MLA up-projection recompute
field.modalities.help: Extra input encoders, comma-separated (image, audio). Leave empty for text-only models; datasets are auto-detected.
field.modalities.label: Modalities
field.moe_chunk_tokens.help: Dispatch tokens to the experts in chunks of this size, each recomputed in the backward pass. 0 = one dispatch. Exact.
field.moe_chunk_tokens.label: MoE chunk tokens
field.moe_intermediate_size.help: Hidden width of each expert's feed-forward network. 0 derives it from the hidden size.
field.moe_intermediate_size.label: Expert FFN width
field.num_attention_heads.help: Query heads. Hidden size must divide evenly by this number.
field.num_attention_heads.label: Attention heads
field.num_experts.help: Routed experts per MoE layer. More experts add capacity without adding per-token compute; they are the unit of lazy loading.
field.num_experts.label: Experts
field.num_experts_per_tok.help: Experts each token uses. Top-2 lets the router learn from the loss; top-1 needs norm_topk_prob off.
field.num_experts_per_tok.label: Active experts (top-k)
field.num_generations.help: Samples per prompt that GRPO compares.
field.num_generations.label: Rollouts per prompt
field.num_hidden_layers.help: Distinct transformer layers stored in the checkpoint (prelude + recurrent groups + coda). Recurrence reuses them, so virtual depth can be larger.
field.num_hidden_layers.label: Physical layers
field.num_key_value_heads.help: Key/value heads for grouped-query attention on sliding-window layers. Fewer heads shrink the KV cache.
field.num_key_value_heads.label: KV heads
field.num_shared_experts.help: Always-on experts every token passes through. They stay resident in memory.
field.num_shared_experts.label: Shared experts
field.num_workers.help: Data-loader worker processes. auto picks a safe number for the platform.
field.num_workers.label: Data workers
field.optimizer_page_dir.help: Folder for paged optimizer state. Use a fast local SSD.
field.optimizer_page_dir.label: Optimizer page dir
field.optimizer_paging.help: Store optimizer state for inactive experts on disk.
field.optimizer_paging.label: Paged optimizer
field.page_size_mb.help: Size of one optimizer page file, in MB.
field.page_size_mb.label: Page size
field.pinned_memory_max_fraction.help: Largest fraction of system RAM used for pinned expert buffers.
field.pinned_memory_max_fraction.label: Pinned RAM share
field.plan.active_mode.help: Set the per-token budget as a number of experts or as active parameters.
field.plan.active_mode.label: Active budget by
field.plan.active_value.help: Active experts per token, or active parameters in millions.
field.plan.active_value.label: Active budget
field.plan.data_paths.help: Files or folders the planner measures to size tokens, sequence length and windows, one per line.
field.plan.data_paths.label: Datasets
field.plan.depth.label: Recurrent depth
field.plan.memory_saving.help: How hard to trade speed for memory (int8 KV, shared routing, checkpointing).
field.plan.memory_saving.label: Memory saving
field.plan.num_experts.label: Experts
field.plan.ram_gb.help: Memory to plan for. Empty detects this machine.
field.plan.ram_gb.label: RAM (GB)
field.plan.seq_len.help: Empty derives it from the dataset profile.
field.plan.seq_len.label: Sequence length
field.plan.target_m.label: Target size (M)
field.plan.token_budget_b.help: Pretraining tokens in billions. Empty: one pass over the data.
field.plan.token_budget_b.label: Token budget (B)
field.plan.use_moe.help: Plan an MoE model; off plans a dense one.
field.plan.use_moe.label: Mixture of experts
field.plan.vocab_size.help: Empty reads it from the tokenizer report; with no report it uses 32768 and the bundled general 32k tokenizer.
field.plan.vocab_size.label: Vocabulary
field.ponder_loss_coef.help: Penalty on the expected number of iterations. Higher pushes the model to stop earlier.
field.ponder_loss_coef.label: Ponder loss
field.prefetch_depth.help: How far ahead the prefetcher loads predicted experts. 0 disables prefetching.
field.prefetch_depth.label: Prefetch depth
field.prelude_layers.help: Layers that run once before the loop. Lookahead routing reads their output.
field.prelude_layers.label: Prelude layers
field.probe.backends.help: Runtimes to test. Each backend gets its own full-memory reference.
field.probe.backends.label: Probe backends
field.probe.decode_wait_s.help: How long a decode step waits for a prefetched expert before loading it on demand.
field.probe.decode_wait_s.label: Decode wait (s)
field.probe.draft_depth.help: Recurrent depth used to draft tokens in speculative variants.
field.probe.draft_depth.label: Draft depth
field.probe.enabled.help: After every validation, decode the fresh checkpoint with lazy experts and compare it with full memory: speed, hit rates and token agreement. Runs in a low-priority child process on a copy of the checkpoint.
field.probe.enabled.label: Lazy-expert probe
field.probe.gamma.help: Tokens drafted per verify pass in speculative variants.
field.probe.gamma.label: Draft length γ
field.probe.max_new_tokens.help: Greedy tokens decoded per prompt. More gives steadier rates but a longer probe.
field.probe.max_new_tokens.label: Tokens per prompt
field.probe.max_variants.help: Upper bound on tested combinations; extra ones are reported as truncated.
field.probe.max_variants.label: Variant cap
field.probe.miss_policies.help: Torch behaviour on a cache miss. sync_on_demand loads and waits (identical output); on_demand may skip late experts; fallback_diagnostic never loads (worst case).
field.probe.miss_policies.label: Miss policies
field.probe.paging.help: auto follows how the model was trained (cluster pages when the cluster-locality loss was on). Add expert to compare per-expert paging.
field.probe.paging.label: Paging layouts
field.probe.ram_ratios.help: Fraction of all experts allowed in RAM at once. Lower saves memory and raises misses.
field.probe.ram_ratios.label: RAM ratios
field.probe.residency.help: MLX eviction: planned uses the next-use planner, window is the plain recent-use window.
field.probe.residency.label: Residency policies
field.probe.residency_decay.help: How fast the next-use planner forgets older routing evidence.
field.probe.residency_decay.label: Planner decay
field.probe.speculative.help: Also test self-speculative decoding with lazy experts.
field.probe.speculative.label: Speculative variants
field.probe.verify_wait_s.help: Same wait for the speculative verify pass.
field.probe.verify_wait_s.label: Verify wait (s)
field.ram_budget_mb.help: RAM the lazy expert cache may use, in MB. Empty uses the RAM ratio instead.
field.ram_budget_mb.label: RAM budget
field.recompute_policy.help: Which blocks are recomputed when checkpointing is on: all, only global (MLA) blocks, only sliding-window blocks, or every second block.
field.recompute_policy.label: Recompute blocks
field.recompute_scope.help: block: recompute whole blocks (most memory saved). mlp: recompute only each block's MoE/FFN, which keeps the attention results and costs less time.
field.recompute_scope.label: Recompute scope
field.recurrent_attention_mode.help: How attention runs inside the loop. shared_first: every iteration attends, K/V from iteration 0 (exact cache, KV does not grow with depth). per_iteration: one KV per iteration (D× KV). first_only: v2 behaviour.
field.recurrent_attention_mode.label: Recurrent attention
field.recurrent_depth.help: Iterations of each recurrent group during training. Virtual layers = prelude + groups × depth + coda.
field.recurrent_depth.label: Training depth
field.recurrent_depth_jitter.help: Random spread around the scheduled depth, so the model learns to exit at several depths.
field.recurrent_depth_jitter.label: Depth jitter
field.recurrent_distill_coef.help: Teaches shallow exits to match full-depth predictions. Raises speculative acceptance and early-exit quality.
field.recurrent_distill_coef.label: Depth distillation
field.recurrent_dt_init.help: Starting value of the learned loop step size dt, the same for every recurrent group. One iteration is an Euler step, so depth x dt is the integration horizon T. The planner sets dt = min(0.5, 2 / depth), which holds T = 2: 0.5 at depth 4, 0.25 at depth 8. Measured at 15M (one seed per arm): the loss is flat for dt from 0.2 to 0.5 at depth 4; at depth 8, dt 0.25 beat 0.5 and a start of 0.0625 was far worse. T = 2 is a safe start, not a fitted optimum: a sigmoid run that started there settled at T of about 1.2. The kernel default stays 0.25.
field.recurrent_dt_init.label: Initial step size
field.recurrent_dt_max.help: Upper bound of dt. 1.0 applies the whole block update to the residual stream in one iteration.
field.recurrent_dt_max.label: Largest step size
field.recurrent_dt_min.help: Lower bound of dt. With the clamp parameterisation a dt that reaches it stops learning; at the default 0.05, dt collapsed onto this bound in our depth-4 and depth-8 runs.
field.recurrent_dt_min.label: Smallest step size
field.recurrent_dt_param.help: How the learned loop step size dt is stored. clamp: dt = clamp(w, dt_min, dt_max); the gradient is zero once w leaves the range, so a dt that falls below dt_min can never come back. sigmoid: dt = dt_min + (dt_max - dt_min) * sigmoid(w); the gradient never vanishes, so dt can still move. Both start at the configured initial dt. Measured in a 15M model (one seed per arm): the clamp default let dt collapse onto its floor of 0.05, which was worse at equal step than a healthy dt; a sigmoid dt kept moving and settled where the loss was flat. The planner recommends sigmoid.
field.recurrent_dt_param.label: Step-size parameterisation
field.recurrent_enabled.help: Run the shared middle groups several times per token, so a small set of weights acts like a deeper network.
field.recurrent_enabled.label: Recurrent depth
field.recurrent_groups.help: How many layers between prelude and coda form looping groups. Empty derives it from layers − prelude − coda.
field.recurrent_groups.label: Recurrent groups
field.recurrent_later_groups.help: Block order only: loop iterations after the first run only the first N layers of the block (0 = all layers). Fewer layer calls make deeper iterations cheaper and touch fewer expert pages. Needs shared_first or first_only attention.
field.recurrent_later_groups.label: Later-iteration layers
field.recurrent_later_topk.help: Experts per token in loop iterations after the first (0 = same as the first iteration). The shared expert always runs. A smaller value makes deeper iterations cheaper and loads fewer expert pages.
field.recurrent_later_topk.label: Later-iteration top-k
field.recurrent_order.help: Order of the loop. layer: each recurrent layer repeats depth times in a row. block: the whole group of recurrent layers repeats, so iteration 0 is a normal depth-1 pass and the loop refines it. Changes the computation: not interchangeable with a layer-order checkpoint. Measured at 15M (one seed per arm): with a trainable step size block had the lower loss at equal step; with step sizes fixed at 1.0 layer won late. The planner recommends block.
field.recurrent_order.label: Loop order
field.recurrent_stability_coef.help: Keeps the recurrent update contractive so repeated iterations do not drift or explode.
field.recurrent_stability_coef.label: Stability loss
field.recurrent_strategy.help: Sampling strategy for the recurrent depth bucket during training.
field.recurrent_strategy.label: Depth strategy
field.reset_lookahead_at_documents.help: Empty follows the router switch above; true or false sets the lookahead terms on their own.
field.reset_lookahead_at_documents.label: Reset lookahead at documents
field.reset_router_at_documents.help: Packed rows: the temporal and locality losses skip token pairs that straddle a document boundary.
field.reset_router_at_documents.label: Reset router at documents
field.reward_spec.help: toy for the built-in reward, or lm:/path/to/reward-model[,device=cuda].
field.reward_spec.label: Reward (GRPO)
field.rope_dim.help: Dimensions per head that carry rotary position information in MLA layers.
field.rope_dim.label: RoPE dims
field.rope_theta.help: Rotary position base frequency. Larger values stretch positional resolution for longer contexts.
field.rope_theta.label: RoPE base
field.router_scope.help: per_iteration: route again on every loop iteration. shared: reuse iteration 0's routing, which touches fewer experts and suits lazy loading.
field.router_scope.label: Router scope
field.save_dir.help: Where checkpoints and their .config.json sidecars are written.
field.save_dir.label: Checkpoint folder
field.save_interval.label: Save interval
field.serve.allow_remote.help: Listen on a non-loopback address. Requires CHRONOS_API_KEY in the server's environment; clients must send it.
field.serve.allow_remote.label: Allow remote access
field.serve.device.label: Device
field.serve.dtype.label: Dtype
field.serve.host.help: Address to listen on. 127.0.0.1 is reachable from this machine only.
field.serve.host.label: Host
field.serve.kv_cache_dtype.help: Override the KV storage. int8 roughly halves KV memory; empty keeps the model setting.
field.serve.kv_cache_dtype.label: KV cache dtype
field.serve.lazy_experts.help: Keep experts on SSD and page them in on demand, so memory stays low through the Ollama protocol too.
field.serve.lazy_experts.label: Lazy experts
field.serve.max_resident_experts.help: Hard cap on experts in RAM per layer. Empty: derived from the RAM share.
field.serve.max_resident_experts.label: Max resident experts
field.serve.mla_cache_rope.help: Cache rotated keys: more memory, less recomputation.
field.serve.mla_cache_rope.label: Cache RoPE keys
field.serve.mla_decode.help: Override the MLA decode path. Empty keeps the model setting.
field.serve.mla_decode.label: MLA decode
field.serve.models_dir.help: Folder with exported models; each one appears as an Ollama model name.
field.serve.models_dir.label: Models folder
field.serve.paging.help: auto follows the checkpoint's training (cluster or expert pages).
field.serve.paging.label: Paging layout
field.serve.port.help: TCP port. 11435 avoids clashing with a stock Ollama on 11434.
field.serve.port.label: Port
field.serve.ram_budget_mb.help: Hard cap on expert RAM. Empty: no cap.
field.serve.ram_budget_mb.label: RAM budget (MB)
field.serve.ram_expert_fraction.help: Fraction of experts allowed in RAM.
field.serve.ram_expert_fraction.label: RAM expert share
field.serve.router_scope.help: Override routing reuse across iterations. Empty keeps the model setting.
field.serve.router_scope.label: Router scope
field.sliding_window_size.help: Tokens each sliding-window layer can see. Short windows suit sentence-level tasks and cap KV memory.
field.sliding_window_size.label: Sliding window
field.storage_format.help: File format of the on-disk expert store.
field.storage_format.label: Expert storage
field.temperature.label: Rollout temperature
field.temporal_grad_span.help: Cut the temporal-locality gradient chain every this many positions. 0 = full chain. Measured neutral on the en-zh data.
field.temporal_grad_span.label: Temporal gradient span
field.tie_word_embeddings.help: Share the input embedding with the output head. Saves vocab × hidden parameters with little quality cost at small sizes.
field.tie_word_embeddings.label: Tie embeddings
field.tok.fields.help: JSON fields to read. Empty auto-detects text, conversations and pairs.
field.tok.fields.label: Text fields
field.tok.out_dir.help: Where tokenizer.json, the chat template and the report are written.
field.tok.out_dir.label: Output folder
field.tok.paths.help: Files or folders to sample text from, one per line. Each source is sampled on its own quota, not merged.
field.tok.paths.label: Source files
field.tok.per_source.help: Reservoir sample size per source file.
field.tok.per_source.label: Texts per source
field.tok.temperature.help: Balances languages by byte share. Lower evens them out, so English does not crowd out Chinese.
field.tok.temperature.label: Language temperature
field.tok.vocab_size.help: Number of tokens to learn. Set the model's vocabulary to the same value.
field.tok.vocab_size.label: Vocabulary size
field.tokenizer_path.help: Tokenizer folder (tokenizer.json) the model is trained with. Empty uses the checkpoint's own tokenizer, else the bundled fallback. The vocabulary size must match.
field.tokenizer_path.label: Tokenizer
field.train.backend.help: Device to train on. Auto picks MLX on Apple silicon, then CUDA, XPU, MPS, CPU.
field.train.backend.label: Training backend
field.train.data_distill.help: Text or chat data scored by the teacher model. Files or folders, one per line; several are merged. Empty reuses the first stage's dataset.
field.train.data_distill.label: Distillation data
field.train.data_dpo.help: Preference pairs with chosen and rejected replies. Files or folders, one per line; several are merged. Empty reuses the first stage's dataset.
field.train.data_dpo.label: DPO data
field.train.data_grpo.help: Prompts for reward rollouts. Files or folders, one per line; several are merged. Empty reuses the first stage's dataset.
field.train.data_grpo.label: GRPO data
field.train.data_orpo.help: Preference pairs with chosen and rejected replies, as for DPO. Files or folders, one per line; several are merged. Empty reuses the first stage's dataset.
field.train.data_orpo.label: ORPO data
field.train.data_path.help: Datasets for the first stage: JSONL, JSON, Parquet, CSV, TSV or TXT files, or folders of them, one per line. Several are merged into one JSONL file in the run folder. Empty runs a synthetic smoke test.
field.train.data_path.label: Dataset
field.train.data_sft.help: Chat data with conversations (user / assistant turns). Files or folders, one per line; several are merged. Empty reuses the first stage's dataset.
field.train.data_sft.label: Supervised fine-tuning data
field.train.init_weight.help: Checkpoint to start from. Empty: pretrain starts from random init, later stages from the previous stage.
field.train.init_weight.label: Start from
field.train.max_steps.help: Stop after this many optimizer steps. 0 runs the configured epochs.
field.train.max_steps.label: Max steps
field.train.sample_prompt.help: Prompt the trainer completes at intervals so you can read progress. Empty uses the stage default.
field.train.sample_prompt.label: Sample prompt
field.train.stages.help: Stages run in order; each starts from the previous stage's checkpoint. Pretrain → SFT is the usual path.
field.train.stages.label: Stages
field.train.teacher_path.help: Distillation only: the model whose outputs the student learns to match.
field.train.teacher_path.label: Teacher checkpoint
field.train.val_ratio.help: Share of records held out for validation. Each validation also triggers the lazy-expert probe.
field.train.val_ratio.label: Validation split
field.training_paging.help: Keep inactive experts out of memory during training. Slower, but trains models larger than RAM.
field.training_paging.label: Paged training
field.tune.data_path.help: Datasets checked before auto-tune starts, one per line. The current probe trials train on random tokens, so this data does not change the trial losses.
field.tune.data_path.label: Dataset
field.tune.n_trials.label: Trials
field.tune.probe_steps.help: Training steps per trial; poor trials are pruned early.
field.tune.probe_steps.label: Steps per trial
field.tune.search.label: Search over
field.use_hybrid_attention.help: Alternate MLA (compressed latent KV) and sliding-window layers. Keeps the KV cache small at long context.
field.use_hybrid_attention.label: Hybrid attention
field.vocab_size.help: Number of token ids. It must equal the tokenizer's vocabulary, otherwise ids fall outside the embedding table.
field.vocab_size.label: Vocabulary size
field.vram_budget_gb.help: Accelerator memory the expert cache may use, in GB.
field.vram_budget_gb.label: VRAM budget
field.weight_decay.label: Weight decay
infer.arch_note: The architecture is read from the checkpoint's config file; the Model page fills only what the file lacks.
infer.intro: Run one prompt with lazy experts and with full memory, then compare outputs, speed, hit rates and memory.
infer.measured_note: Measured on this machine for this prompt; a single run, not an average.
infer.prompt_help: Text sent to the model. The SFT chat template is applied unless Raw prompt is on.
infer.title: Inference
io.empty: No metrics yet. They appear while inference or serving runs in this process.
io.intro: Expert cache and IO counters recorded by inference and serving in this server process.
io.title: IO and cache metrics
mon.intro: Live view of any run folder, including long runs started from the command line. Read-only.
mon.no_runs: No runs yet. Start one on the Train page.
mon.phase_note: Steps restart in every stage, so charts show one stage at a time.
mon.title: Run monitor
picker.browse_tip: Browse folders on the server's machine inside the page and pick a path.
picker.empty: No matching files or folders here
picker.multi_hint: You can add several files or folders; they are merged before training.
picker.native_fallback: This machine cannot open a system file dialog, so the files will be uploaded instead.
picker.native_tip: Open the system file manager. Nothing is copied; the chosen path is used as it is.
picker.placeholder_multi: One path per line, or use Add…
picker.this_folder: Nothing selected: this folder will be used ({path})
picker.truncated: Showing the first {n} entries; type a path to go deeper
picker.upload_tip: Pick files with this device's file manager. They are uploaded to the uploads folder on the server's machine, and that path is filled in.
picker.uploaded_skipped: Uploaded {n} files; skipped {skipped} hidden or wrong-type files.
picker.will_merge: {n} paths will be merged into one JSONL file before use.
plan.note: The planner searches a configuration for the target size, data and memory; review it before training.
plan.title: Auto plan
preset.b1.summary: 1B MoE with 64 fine-grained experts and aggressive memory saving.
preset.m200.summary: General 200M MoE with balanced memory saving and the legacy 6400-token vocabulary.
preset.m50.summary: 50M MoE with 36 experts (top-2) for a 16k Chronos tokenizer; no memory saving.
preset.m500.summary: 500M MoE with aggressive memory saving: int8 KV, shared routing, activation checkpointing.
preset.tiny.summary: 1.5M smoke test; trains in minutes on CPU.
probe.conditions: Greedy decoding, {n} prompts, {t} tokens each; measured.
probe.history: Hit rate and agreement over training
probe.history_note: One probe after each validation; steps restart in every phase, so only the newest phase is plotted.
probe.none: No probe yet. One runs after each validation.
probe.skip.busy: the previous probe is still running
probe.skip.dense: dense model, no routed experts to page
probe.skip.superseded: replaced by the newer validation at step {step}
probe.skip.writing: the checkpoint is still being written
probe.title: Lazy-expert probe
rule.sync_is_exact: sync_on_demand: output identical to full memory
rule.window_median_record: power of two nearest the median record length (32 when unknown)
serve.auth_off: No key: reachable from this machine only.
serve.auth_on: Clients must send the API key.
serve.intro: Start chronos serve: Ollama and OpenAI clients connect to it while experts stay lazy-loaded.
serve.remote_warning: Binding beyond this machine needs Allow remote and a key in CHRONOS_API_KEY; without a key the server refuses to start.
serve.title: Ollama / OpenAI-compatible server
tok.intro: Train a Chronos tokenizer from your own data: sampling, normalisation, byte-fallback BPE and a held-out report.
tok.report_note: Measured on held-out text that was not used to train the tokenizer.
tok.title: Chronos tokenizer builder
train.config_note: The architecture comes from the Model page; per-stage learning rates come from the plan when one was applied.
train.intro: Start a training job with the model settings from the Model page. Progress appears in the monitor.
train.probe_note: Each validation decodes the newly saved checkpoint with lazy experts and with full memory. The probe runs as a low-priority child on a copy, so training continues.
train.probe_off: The lazy-expert check is off for this job.
train.stage_data_note: Each stage after the first reads its own data format. Leave a row empty to reuse the first stage's dataset.
train.title: Train
train.variants_capped: {n} combinations requested, the first {cap} are tested
tune.intro: Search training settings with Optuna TPE: each trial trains a few steps and reports its loss.
tune.note: Probe loss after a short run; a ranking signal, not a final quality measure.
tune.title: Auto-tune (Optuna TPE)
ui.access_tip.lan: You are connected over the LAN. "Upload…" sends files to the uploads folder on the server's machine and uses that path. "Browse…" lists files on the server's machine.
ui.access_tip.lan_local: You opened the UI on the server's own machine, so no sign-in is needed. "Upload…" opens the system file manager and uses the original path. Other devices on the LAN need the access key.
ui.access_tip.local_only: The UI listens on this machine only (127.0.0.1); other devices cannot open it and no sign-in is needed. Start with --lan to allow LAN access.
ui.busy: Another job of this kind is running
ui.login_blocked: Too many failed attempts. Wait 5 minutes.
ui.login_needed: This workbench needs the access key set on the server.
